cover.title: Discover the Magic of Vinyl
cover.subtitle: Explore our curated collection of premium vinyl records. From classic jazz to modern indie, we have something for every music lover.
cover.aboutSubtitle:
Founded in 2010, Vinyl Heaven started as a small corner shop with just a few hundred records. Our founder, Sarah, began collecting vinyl at age 15 and never stopped. What started as a personal collection soon grew into something much bigger.

Today, we house over 10,000 carefully curated vinyl records from every genre and era. From classic jazz to modern indie, we've handpicked each album for its quality, rarity, and cultural significance.

We believe that vinyl isn't just about nostalgia—it's about experiencing music the way artists intended, with all the warmth, depth, and character that digital formats simply can't replicate.

collections.title: Featured Collections
collections.subtitle: Explore our handpicked collections of vinyl records from various genres and eras.

titleWithButton.aboutDescription: At Vinyl Heaven, we're dedicated to preserving the authentic sound experience that only vinyl can provide. Our journey began with a simple love for music and has evolved into a mission to share that passion with collectors worldwide.
titleWithButton.contactDescription: Have questions or feedback? Fill out the form below and we'll respond shortly.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: We meticulously inspect each record for audio quality and physical condition before adding it to our collection.

authenticity.title: Authenticity
authenticity.description: We believe in the authentic vinyl experience, from the artwork to the warm analog sound that digital can't match.

curation.title: Curation
curation.description: Each collection is thoughtfully curated to tell a story and provide a journey through musical history and culture.

sarah.name: Sarah Johnson
sarah.description: With 20+ years in vinyl collecting, Sarah uncovers the rarest pressings and shapes our unique catalog.

michael.name: Michael Lee
michael.description: A crate-digging veteran, Michael's expertise guarantees every record meets audiophile standards.

emily.name: Emily Davis
emily.description: With a flair for storytelling, Emily connects our community through events, newsletters and social media.

david.name: David Kim
david.description: David ensures your vinyl arrives safely—coordinating shipments from our warehouse to your doorstep.
